entry.title: AI Adoption Reaches 92.4%, Yet Content Marketing Results Hit a 12-Year Low
entry.summary: AI is now part of almost every blogging workflow, but Orbit Media's latest survey suggests that widespread adoption has not improved content marketing performance.
